tools.name: arif_init
tools.description: KERNEL 000 · Ignite a governed kernel session: binds actor identity, constitutional floors F1–F13, and the audit chain. Returns the session_id + session_token that every other arif_* verb requires. Use mode=preflight to inspect an existing session without re-igniting, mode=resume to continue one. Mo

tools.name: arif_observe
tools.description: KERNEL 111 · Collect evidence — facts and sources with epistemic tags (OBS) and uncertainty bounds, never conclusions. mode=search queries the open web/literature; mode=fetch retrieves a URL and records its provenance; mode=vitals reads kernel machine telemetry. Reason over what you gathered with ar

tools.name: arif_think
tools.description: KERNEL 333 · Structured reasoning pass: decomposes a query and returns reasoning steps labeled OBS (observed), DER (derived), INT (interpretation), SPEC (specification) under truth floors. Produces reasoning records only — no verdicts (those come from arif_judge) and no state changes. The plan-famil

tools.name: arif_route
tools.description: KERNEL 444 · Intent→organ router: classifies a natural-language intent and prepares a dispatch envelope for the specialist organ (GEOX geoscience, WEALTH capital, WELL vitality, A-FORGE execution). Returns the routing decision and target organ contract. Calling the organ tool itself is a separate go

tools.name: arif_memory
tools.description: KERNEL 555 · Governed memory of the kernel itself: six tiers (L1–L6) with per-mode gating. recall, inspect, and audit are read paths; remember, revise, promote, and forget mutate tiers — promote and forget additionally require human_approval=true. Use for cross-session lessons, canon, and memory aud

tools.name: arif_judge
tools.description: KERNEL 666 · Binding constitutional arbitration: evaluates a candidate action or claim and returns SEAL / HOLD / SABAR / VOID with the full reason chain. Weighs action class, blast radius, reversibility, entropy pathway, and cooling state; a SEAL verdict here is what arif_forge requires before it wi

tools.name: arif_forge
tools.description: KERNEL 777 · Governed execution: applies a mutation through A-FORGE only when carrying a sealed verdict id (seal_verdict_id) from arif_judge and a live session. The manifest/query defines exactly what changes; mode=dry_run previews the plan without applying it. This is the only verb that executes ge

tools.name: arif_seal
tools.description: KERNEL 999 · Append an entry to VAULT999, the immutable ledger — accepted entries can never be edited or removed; there is no unseal. Use for permanent records of verified outcomes, lessons, and session closure once a verdict exists. ack_irreversible=true is the explicit acknowledgment of permanence

tools.name: arif_report
tools.description: AGENT REPORT LANE · File or read reports between agents without involving the human. Use when your work is done, when you are blocked by another agent, or when you need to tell peers a fact. modes: report (file), inbox (read peers), ack, flush, stats. kind=fyi|peer|done|claim stay in the peer lane;
